zh-HK: Snack Package 載入模板時同產品資料庫對比：自動列出同類（Sub-Category／Category／Family／Section）但模板未有嘅產品補充入模板，可逐項揀；冇成本／冇售價產品可選擇包括；可複製或匯出 Excel
載入模板亦會列出成本／售價同資料庫唔同嘅項目（可更新），以及資料庫已冇（可能停售）嘅產品（可移除或保留標記）
管理 Customer Solution 全新介面：卡片清單、搜尋、左右兩欄編輯、即時匹配數；新增關鍵字（例如 fruit）、排除關鍵字／Item Code，預覽表可直接剔走或剔返
mePrice 設置改版：對照表只填「由」同「目標」（自動接駁冇空隙）、即時驗證、曲線圖、試算實際 mePrice、全部 ±1pp、未保存提示
下載客戶庫／產品庫可直接存入 CSV 資料夾（backup 子資料夾）、另存為或瀏覽器下載；檔名加日期唔會覆蓋
反推定價新增「📈 售價 ±%」：每行售價按同一 % 直接加／減（例：+25%、−10%），可按現有售價或 Band 參考價計，預設有封底保護
反推定價新增「🗂 Section Margin」：按產品 Section 填目標 margin（例：1 → 30%、2 → 40%、5 → 15%），售價直接 = 成本 ÷ (1 − margin%)，設定會記住
CSV 資料夾自動載入取消預設密碼：預設冇密碼，開平台直接載入；想要密碼可喺「📂 資料夾載入」自行設定、更改或移除（仍用舊預設密碼嘅設定會自動移除）
忘記密碼改為「抹除並重設」：抹除密碼、「記住呢部電腦」及資料夾連結（已載入資料、草稿唔受影響），再設新密碼（可唔設）及重新揀資料夾；使用教學新增「反推定價（◎）」
en: Snack Package: loading a template now compares it with the product database and suggests same-category items it lacks (pick per item, optional no-price items, copy / Excel export)
Template load also lists cost / price differences (update optional) and template items no longer in the database (remove or keep flagged)
Customer Solutions redesigned: card list, search, two-column editor, live match counts; new keyword (e.g. fruit) and exclude rules, tick / untick items in the preview
mePrice settings redesigned: enter only 'from' and target per band (no gaps), live checks, curve chart, real mePrice tester, all ±1pp, unsaved warning
Customer / product DB downloads can save straight into the CSV folder (backup subfolder), Save As or downloads; dated file names, never overwrite
Reverse pricing: new "📈 Price ±%" mode moves every row by the same % (e.g. +25%, −10%) from the current or band price; floor protection on by default
Reverse pricing: new "🗂 Section Margin" mode prices each product Section from a target margin (e.g. 1 → 30%, 5 → 15%): price = cost ÷ (1 − margin%)
CSV folder auto-load has no default password any more: the folder loads on launch; set, change or remove your own in "📂 Folder sync"
Forgot password is now "Erase & reset": clears the password and folder link (data and drafts stay), then pick the folder again; user guide adds "Reverse pricing (◎)"
